doubts.q: The second-time AI journey (905:297062 -> 905:297092) has no title card, and its Arrow 2 (967:351899) points at empty canvas around (11537, 2880) instead of a frame. Arrow 1 from the first-time journey lands on 875:165388. Does the second-time user also continue into 875:165388 and the same long row (3 ... 138)?
doubts.proposedDefault: Yes: second-time journey = 905:297062 -> 905:297092 -> joins create-ai-first-time at 875:165388 and follows it to the end (recorded as joinsAt).

doubts.q: Under the 'Create Routine manually' card there is an untitled group (Group 1739333097, 12860:497672): a 30%-opacity screen '161', 11 side-panel variants marked 'updated', then '145' (1440x1145), an 'Instructions' full-screen modal and two 'Summary' modal screens '35'/'36'. Is this the continuation of 'Create Routine manually', and is '14' (280 rail, not dimmed) or '161' (56 rail, newer, dimmed) the screen to build?
doubts.proposedDefault: Treat the group as the rest of create-manually: 14 -> 145 -> Instructions modal -> Summary 35 -> Summary 36; side panels are panel states (components); '161' stays a parked alternate of '14'.

doubts.q: In 'Scheduled sessions view' the label 'Error in run' is right-aligned over frame 4 (1596:364052, 'Run View: Only one Run') and ends just before 1596:367279. Which frame is the error state?
doubts.proposedDefault: 1596:367279 (the next frame, same 1109 height) is the error-in-run state; 1596:364052 is the single-run view.

doubts.q: The captions 'On click' and 'View Instructions' sit between the two 'View & edit' rows, aligned with the upper row's columns (1174:212998, 1174:209018), not over any 'Read more behavior' frame. Do they caption the upper row?
doubts.proposedDefault: Yes: they caption the upper-row frames ('On click' under 1174:212998 opens 1174:209018; 'View Instructions' under 1174:209018 leads to 3413:112115 Instructions).
